cases.title: Watch offer, the learner says yes: two focus entries (Door first, then Needle), Needle's place in one sentence, A and Shift+P asked first, the demo only on Needle

checks.detail: turn 3: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: After the yes in Turn 3, the mentor set focus to Door then Needle. It said Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge.") and asked for A then Shift+P before moving anything. In Turn 4 anchor_demo ran on Needle only, and Door was left to the learner.

Turn 4 follows the required order: the A/Shift+P ask, a preview frame, anchor_demo on Needle, then a second frame at 0 s. The mentor says "Anchor Point and Position both changed, but Needle didn't move" and points to Edit > Undo. It reads out no values and adds no claim about how the numbers changed.

Turn 4 reports one change in plain words with real names ("I moved Needle's pivot… now at the middle of its bottom edge", matching the tool's place) and gives Edit > Undo with no undo label. It then hands Door to the learner ("Now it's your turn with Door") without offering to do it.

Every name the mentor uses appears in or follows from tool output: Door, Needle, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s, Needle's bottom-middle place and Door's middle-left place. Door being "a tall panel in the upper-left" follows from its layer_bounds in Turn 2.
